name: Swagelok
india_angle: Swagelok has a significant presence in India with authorized sales and service centers in Bangalore and Bombay, covering various regions including South and North India, Sri Lanka, and Maldives.
summary: Swagelok provides a wide range of fluid system components and services, including fittings, valves, hoses, and custom solutions, which are crucial for maintaining and optimizing semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Their offerings support the infrastructure needs of semiconductor fabs and other high-tech industries.
